previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a right-handed male with mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma involving the central nervous system, was admitted for his second maintenance cycle of high-dose methotrexate. He tolerated the chemotherapy well, with close monitoring for renal and hepatic toxicity. His leucovorin was started at 12 hours post-infusion due to prior liver enzyme elevations. Mild transaminitis occurred but resolved by discharge. A brain MRI showed no progression of disease. He received rituximab but developed rigors during infusion, consistent with a mild allergic reaction, and was treated with solumedrol and a prednisone taper. He was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to complete the steroid taper, continue bowel regimen, and follow up for ocular evaluation and lab monitoring.

Brief Hospital Course:
___ is a ___ right-handed man with a history 
of mixed HD/NHL with CNS and ocular involvement presenting for 
scheduled admission for rituximab.  

Patient was given methotrexate and rituximab on ___ and 
pretreated with dexamethasone, Benadryl, ranitidine, and 
acetaminophen. He was also given bicarbonate IV and po to 
promote methotrexate urinary excretion. Leucovorin was initated 
and at the time of discharge, his methotrexate level was 0.2, so 
he was sent home with no additional leucovorin or bicarbonate. 
His hospital course was uncomplicated and he remained afebrile. 
His vital signs were stable. Follow-up was arranged.
